name: table-branch-scope-sync
title: Synchronize table management with selected branch
description: Synchronize legacy manager page branch selectors with the shared manager restaurant scope so changing the header branch reloads that branch's data.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The backend table and floor queries were already scoped correctly. The shared ManagementPageHeader now consumes the existing manager.selectedRestaurantId / manager:scope-selection protocol, applies persisted or newly selected manager branches to legacy page callbacks, and publishes page-level changes back to the shared scope. Tests cover the shared protocol and verify TableManagement passes the new restaurant ID to both table and floor data hooks. Tests/build were not executed locally because the connected environment cannot clone the repository and no workflow run was available for the commit.
